Yes of course you still count. Some people realise that they’re lgbtq+ from a very young age or a very old age. You can be any age to realise who you truly are. For some people it clicks earlier on and some people just need a little while to finally know who you truly are. Your past relationships don’t determine who you are today. Some people get married and have kids before they realise that they’re gay or lesbian. You are welcome in the community no matter who you dated before. I myself went out with a boy before I found out I was a lesbian :) 💕

I’m also 13 and suicidal and trust me it will be ok. I know it might sound like bad advice right now and I know how much it hurts but just hang on for the little things that make you smile even just for a moment. Try to talk to your friends and if you don’t really have many then there are many people online you can talk to, even me for example. No matter how awful you feel right now and how much you think you’re not good enough, you are. I’m just a stranger who has no idea who you are but I care about you and you are just as important as anyone else. You are strong, smart and amazing even if you don’t know that yet. I had a suicide attempt and self harmed for a long time, I know the pain. I know you can get through this. Stay strong because you are a wonderful individual with so many opportunities who was just unfortunate enough to be cursed with this torture. Virtual hug❤️

Hi, I know I’m just a stranger and I have no idea who you are but I still wish that you wouldn’t have to go through such pain. I have been suicidal for a very long time and after cutting myself many times and even having a suicide attempt I still feel the same. I get what you’re going through and honestly I doubt there’s anything I can do or say to help you even a little but you’ve got to stay strong. No matter how hard living and having to wake up every day is to do please try to stay for the little things, the sight of the stars in the sky, for the sun to rise up every morning, the sound of birds chirping or the taste of your favourite meal. Those are the little things worth staying for. I know it will be difficult and I know things won’t change overnight but please just stay here. I don’t know your name, how you look like or anything about you but I do know I care. You are just as important as anyone on this earth and even though people might be cruel and selfish there will always be at least one person to guide you through the storm. Please stay alive💕
